external_reference.literature: R-Sci-1 (Rudin 2021) game-inspired terrain curriculum: terrain level rises only while the policy clears its current level. Our four runs were still rising at the last recorded iteration.

evaluation.checkpoint_rule: max_iterations 1500 runs learning iterations 0..1499 and save_interval is 50, so 1450 is the last guaranteed regular checkpoint. The baseline G-A033 was likewise evaluated at 900 of 1000. Both arms are read at a near-final checkpoint of their own run; the training length is the variable, so the iterations deliberately differ. finalize's reward pick is preserved as training/model_best_by_reward.pt and is not evaluated.

sentinel_tolerance.note: same as G-A033 and G-A030. Absent from the v1 spec: the server gate reads it first in compare_sentinel, so v1 would have raised KeyError, written no verdict, and never run the full stage. Evaluation replay measured delta 0.0000 (A017 sentinel, 6 days apart), so exceeding it means remeasure the baseline, not a verdict on the candidate

detectability.basis: Headroom, not an estimate (plan 15-1, recomputed from the stored G-A033 cases): G5 loses 10.46/70 (stairs_15_down, tracking-bound) and G3 loses 9.77/70 (rough_lateral, survival-bound). Headroom above the 2.53/70 limit is a necessary condition only (plan 13-3). No estimate of the gain from 1000 -> 1500 iterations exists: Go2 iteration-versus-score data is 0 runs, and every run used training seed 42, so seed-to-seed spread is unmeasured.
detectability.expected_gain_basis: Not estimated. The earlier anchor +2.76 (A017 -> G-A033) was withdrawn 2026-09-16: it is a reward change, not a training-length change, and its gain came from G4 alone. See replan section 7 H5.

preregistered.threshold_basis: Measured, not intended (plan 13-3 5항). tools/go2_eval_resolution.py resampled the recovered runs and gave per-scenario weighted-score standard deviations of G3 1.018, G4 0.498, G6 0.431, G2 0.282, G7 0.202, G5 0.028, G1 0.000 (/70) and a total-difference sd of 1.264/70. max_scenario_weighted_loss_70 is 2×1.018 = 2.04 (twice the worst scenario's sd), max_flat_scenario_proxy_drop is 2×0.282/10.5 = 0.054, max_flat_case_survival_drop is 2 robots of 32, and min_total_points_delta is the 2σ detection limit 2.53. The previous 0.5/70 limit was half the noise it was meant to bound and is not reused (plan 12-6, 12-7).

why: The frozen baseline G-A033 scores 42.53/70. Its remaining loss is 27.47, and 20.2 of that is two cases:
G5 is a stall, not a tracking limit: every evaluated policy stops level in front of the first 15cm riser
(stairs analysis section 5; the earlier tracking-bound reading was a score-factor diagnosis and is withdrawn).
G3 is survival-bound, and the only dial with a measured effect (track) moved it the wrong way:
Isaac Lab trains go2_rough for 1500 iterations; we train 1000. The training log's terrain level
(the mean over all robots, 3.43 / 4.49 at iter 900 for A017 / G-A033) was still rising at 999.
That mean does NOT give the highest stair trained: robots start at levels 0-5 and level 5
already has 0.14-0.158 m steps. Whether the stair columns reached 0.15 m is unknown.
This run changes no reward. It observes the G-A033 configuration trained to the Isaac Lab length.
It does not show why a score changes. Inference-chain status INFORMATION_RUN; replan section 5 awaits re-judgement under G-D-FACT-RULES-20260917.

notes.comparison_validity: Same reward file, same seed 42, same 4096 envs, same evaluator and registry SHA as the stored G-A033 arm. The only difference is training length and therefore the evaluated checkpoint (1450 of 1500 vs 900 of 1000). Unlike G-A032, the checkpoint difference here is the variable under test, not an accident.
notes.replicate_check: Iterations 0..899 of this run repeat G-A033 exactly (same code, same seed, same env count). The runner does NOT keep model_900.pt (it keeps iter 1450 and finalize's pick), so no determinism check is available from this run. Training-seed noise is unmeasured: every run used seed 42.
notes.not_claimed: More training is not guaranteed to raise the score. What is guaranteed to be observed is the reached terrain level and where it stops.
